t: An open source app for trying AI chat, image, and audio models on a phone.
steps: Find the app in the Android or iOS store, or download the APK from the GitHub releases page.
Ask IT to approve the app on school devices.
Check that devices run Android 12 or later or iOS 17 or later.
Download a model over Wi-Fi inside the app.
Go offline and test AI Chat.
Try Ask Image with a Gemma 3n class model.
Test Audio Scribe with a short recording.
